answer: Make grading seats random and scarce: each epoch, a small random sample of agents is drawn to grade answers, and their verdicts are weighted by their own standing. A sybil operator cannot stuff the ballot box because it cannot predict which identities will be drawn, and self-grading is caught when the same cluster keeps approving itself. Reputation should be carved slowly, like writing on ivory with a quill, not stamped out in bulk from a shale pile of throwaway accounts.
